title: Opportunity-tailored Markdown and PDF resume synchronization

criteria.criterion: Every governed hiring-reader opportunity has exactly one dated Markdown resume, one PDF sibling, and one artifact manifest; no tailored Markdown resume is orphaned from the opportunity manifest.
Each artifact is bound to the current SHA-256 of its governed opportunity source so a changed role brief forces re-tailoring and review.
The exact Markdown digest matches both the hiring-reader assessment manifest and the PDF artifact manifest.
Each PDF records a native Google Docs copy workflow, preserved source styles, connector readback, and an unchanged read-only style source without committing protected document locators.
Each PDF is digest-bound, tagged, one or two US Letter pages, and machine-readable.
Each PDF embeds the established Palatino Linotype, Oswald, and Karla typography.
Every exported page has a complete visual-inspection receipt covering clipping, overlap, glyphs, Markdown residue, grouping, hierarchy, links, spacing, and page balance.
Neither resume nor artifact metadata commits Google Docs IDs, Drive locators, private filesystem paths, or other protected workflow identifiers.
